feature_title: Dashboard Print Mode Clear on Leave

rationale.edition: Both changed files live under web/src/ (web/src/views/Dashboards/ViewDashboard.vue and web/src/views/Dashboards/viewDashboard.spec.ts), the OSS frontend tree. No enterprise-owned paths (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) appear, and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) are present in the changed paths or symbol names, so this is an OSS change.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. There is no explicit opt-out (no tests-added label and the trigger comment is empty), and the change touches a real Vue view (ViewDashboard.vue) that alters navigation behavior, so it is user-facing rather than docs/CI/comment-only.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the change adds an onBeforeRouteLeave guard that clears global print mode when the user leaves the dashboard via browser Back (rather than the close button), preventing the app shell from staying hidden. This is a user-visible state/navigation behavior that should be verified end-to-end.
rationale.area: Dashboards — both files live under web/src/views/Dashboards/ and the behavior belongs to the dashboard view; sibling E2E specs would live in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/.
rationale.group: Dashboards — a dashboard-view feature maps to the Dashboards shard group in the ci matrix. The OSS ci_matrix.json is not present in this checkout (only the enterprise overlay ci_matrix.ent.json, which has no Dashboards entry), so 'Dashboards' is the closest existing group; the Engineer should confirm it exists in OSS ci_matrix.json or create it.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The only test file changed is web/src/views/Dashboards/viewDashboard.spec.ts, a Vitest unit test, which is not E2E coverage under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/ and does not set existing_tests_in_diff.
